_note: Channel persona — the remembered 'how this channel sounds / who it's for', read and written by the /make-video Director (Stage 0). Asked once, confirmed thereafter, overridable per video. This is the ai-news niche's persona file, per the multi-channel convention (channel-persona.<niche-id>.json). brand.md stays the VISUAL/sound contract; this is the per-channel default choices layered on top.
_name_resolved: UPDATED 2026-08-14 (user's explicit directive): Channel rebranded to 'AI Enthusiast'. All legacy 'under 3 minutes' constraints and verdict caps are removed. Focus is in-depth, hands-on, benchmark-verified AI breakdowns, agent workflows, tool reviews, and developer insights.
channel_tagline: In-depth breakdowns, hands-on tests, benchmarks, and honest analysis of the latest AI models, tools, and breakthroughs.
_delivery_mode_note: News beats (model drops) use breaking-news 1.15x. Deep dives / explainers can use calm-explainer.
tone_flavor: enthusiastic, deeply technical yet accessible, honest, evidence-first; never hype-filler; always explores the real architecture and benchmarks
_tts_speed_note: Breaking news / model drops use 1.15x for energy; explainers use 1.05x-1.10x.
_voice_note: The voice IS the channel identity — personality tag: Warm/Confident/Authentic/Honest.
_default_conversion_note: course | tool | repo | newsletter | nothing — used by /packaging for the description CTA
_target_seconds_note: Scaled naturally to the topic's depth — typically 4 to 12 minutes based on the release.
content_pillars: Model drops — deep-dive coverage of new LLM/AI model releases (architectures, benchmarks, token pricing, what actually changed)
Hands-on tests & tool reviews — AI agents, IDE tools, coding workflows, with live screen recordings and evidence
Explainers & architecture breakdowns — token budgets, speculative decoding, agentic tool loops, and research papers demystified
Robotics & frontier AI roundups — multi-story compilations tracking the frontier of autonomous systems
notes: Every video maintains an evidence-first standard (live terminal runs, screen recordings, spec cards citing exact sources). Honest gap analysis is always included so engineers and builders get real value.
